title: CLAUDE.md
text: R/utils-api.R single chokepoint network /O: pga_graphql_request(operation_name, variables) — POSTs https://orchestrator.pgatour.com/graphql, loads query text inst/graphql/<operation_name>.graphql, sends x-api-key header, throttles 10 req/sec via req_throttle, applies req_timeout(30) + req_retry(max_tries = 3) 408/429/5xx, returns data field. GraphQL errors HTTP ≥400 abort cli_abort. Non-JSON 200 responses caught surfaced via pga_parse_json(). pga_rest_request(path) — GETs https://data-api.pgatour.com/<path>, throttling + timeout + retry, returns parsed JSON. Query strings cached .pga_cache environment, keyed operation name, .graphql file read disk per session. x-api-key public key embedded PGA Tour frontend. bundled default lives .pga_api_key_default; pga_api_key() prefers PGA_API_KEY env var users can swap keys without reinstalling frontend key rotates. Every user-facing pga_*() function R/ thin wrapper: call pga_graphql_request / pga_rest_request, shape result tibble. Add new endpoints dropping .graphql file inst/graphql/ whose stem matches operationName, calling pga_graphql_request("YourOpName", list(...)). Mocking depends call going two transports — anything bypasses hard test.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Several GraphQL operations (ending Compressed, e.g. LeaderboardCompressedV3, ScorecardCompressedV3, shotDetailsV4Compressed, TeeTimesCompressedV2, CurrentLeadersCompressed, oddsToWinCompressed, GenericContentCompressed) return payload string base64-encoded gzip JSON. Pass pga_decompress() R/utils-decompress.R parsing. pga_decompress: Validates input (must non-empty character scalar) wraps step (base64 → gunzip → JSON parse) tryCatch re-throws clear, named error instead cryptic C-level inflateEnd message. Uses jsonlite::fromJSON(..., simplifyVector = TRUE), parsed$players etc. come back data.frame/matrix, list--lists. Flattening code (see R/leaderboard.R) depends shape. top-level field comes back empty list (e.g. parsed$holes = list() shot data exists), guards must check .data.frame() length() calling nrow() — see R/shot_details.R:36–39 pattern.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: R/utils-parse.R: - to_snake_case() / clean_names() — convert API camelCase snake_case columns. - make_unique_snake(x) — sanitize free-form labels (spaces/punctuation) unique snake_case column names. Uses make.unique() duplicate API headers don’t collide. Use whenever building columns dynamic API header strings (StatDetails$statHeaders, pga_player_results header labels, etc.). - validate_tour_code() — "R" (PGA), "S" (Champions), "H" (Korn Ferry) valid. - safe_pluck(x, ...) — nested list access returns NULL instead erroring; used heavily reshaping heterogeneous API responses. Row-binding uses vctrs::vec_rbind() (.call(rbind, ...)) heterogeneous columns across chunks get filled NA instead erroring. vec_cbind() equivalent column binding. %||% (base R 4.4+, package Depends: R (>= 4.1.0)) used throughout — ’s unavailable minimum R version, surface check failure.

title: R Client for the PGA Tour API
text: package wraps PGA Tour’s GraphQL REST APIs: GraphQL endpoint: https://orchestrator.pgatour.com/graphql REST endpoint: https://data-api.pgatour.com Authentication: Uses public API key embedded PGA Tour frontend (user authentication required). frontend key rotates, set Sys.setenv(PGA_API_KEY = "...") override bundled default without reinstalling. Rate limiting: Built-throttling 10 requests/second. Resilience: 30-second timeout, 3-try retry transient failures (408 / 429 / 5xx), clear error messages API returns malformed responses. Several endpoints return gzip+base64 compressed payloads. package handles decompression transparently.

title: R Client for the PGA Tour API
text: httr2 — HTTP requests jsonlite — JSON parsing base64 decoding tibble — Tidy data frames vctrs — Robust row/column binding cli — User-friendly error messages

title: pgatouR (development version)
text: pga_player_tournament_status() now returns zero-row tibble API status report (player currently tournament). previously returned one-row tibble NA columns. column schema unchanged. pga_stats() longer attaches metadata (stat_title, tour_avg, year, display_season) attributes. stat_title, stat_id, year now real columns returned tibble; metadata dropped (silently lost moment dplyr verb ran result anyway).

title: pgatouR (development version)
text: pga_stats() accepts vectors stat_id year, looping internally stacking results stat_id year columns. pga_stats() pga_fedex_cup() gain event_query argument passes upstream StatDetailEventQuery variable. Three new endpoints fill documented API coverage: pga_content() (CMS content), pga_odds_interactivity() (odds widget config), pga_speed_rounds() (speed-rounds video index). PGA_API_KEY env var overrides bundled frontend key users can swap keys without reinstalling public key rotates. PGATOUR_VERBOSE env var enables request-level logging via cli troubleshooting.

title: pgatouR (development version)
text: pga_player_tournament_status(): fixed phantom roundDisplay mapping always NA. fields actually returned API (roundStatusDisplay, roundStatusColor) now surfaced columns. pga_player_results(): hardcoding first season response, silently dropping seasons. Now returns every season season column. pga_player_stats(): rank now integer column rather character. pga_shot_details(): longer crashes “missing value TRUE/FALSE needed” API returns empty holes list (e.g. player tracked shots round). pga_decompress(): malformed payloads (empty string, non-base64, invalid gzip, invalid JSON) now produce clear errors naming failed step instead cryptic C-level messages like inflateEnd -3. Header-derived column names previously collided (e.g. two "Rank" labels player results, free-form spaces stat headers) now deduplicated via make_unique_snake().

title: pgatouR (development version)
text: Transport now applies 30-second req_timeout() three-try req_retry() 408/429/5xx, transient CDN failures recover automatically instead failing call. Non-JSON 200 responses caught surfaced operation name status code, instead crashing resp_body_json(). pga_tee_times() now builds one tibble per group rather per player, drastically reducing allocations large fields. pga_leaderboard() now %||%-guards every player/scoring field partial response API can’t break tibble construction. total_sort score_sort returned numeric (character). pga_tournaments() uses vctrs::vec_rbind() courses list-column heterogeneous course schemas longer silently fall back empty tibble.

title: pgatouR (development version)
text: Added offline test suite (89 tests across 10 files) mocks pga_graphql_request / pga_rest_request fixtures captured tests/testthat/fixtures/. Re-capture Rscript data-raw/fixtures.R. Added R-CMD-check GitHub Actions workflow runs macOS Ubuntu R release, devel, oldrel-1. R/utils-parse.R defines %||% locally package works R versions older 4.4 (%||% landed base). long-form guide moved CRAN-style vignette pkgdown article vignettes/articles/. R CMD check longer tangles runs live API calls.
